notes.title: Kill The Skeletons - Beta Release Update (Update 1.0.5)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551765/1e6ceea31fb02f7db5ea9f7dd0862715b8a8bc3e.png"][/img]⚔️ Kill the Skeletons — Major Update Patch Notes ⚔️[/p][p]Greetings Bone Collectors![/p][p]As development continues, we're temporarily [b]pausing feature expansion[/b] to focus on improving and stabilizing the current game systems.
Our priority during this phase is to enhance existing features, rebalance the mechanics, fix lingering UI issues, and apply much-needed [b]performance optimizations[/b]. This includes refining visual effects and ensuring core systems are more logical, stable, and enjoyable to play with.[/p][p]With that in mind, here’s everything included in this update:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧙 Wizard Reworks & Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Click the Wizard[/b] has been buffed. His prices are now much cheaper and more accessible early on.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lightning Wizard[/b] has been [b]completely reworked[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Now truly casts [b]Chain Lightning[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Enters a visible [b]casting animation[/b] when attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual clarity and effects have been overhauled.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ System & Economy Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Gold has been removed[/b] from the game.[/p][list][*][p]Players now collect [b]Bones[/b] directly from skeletons.[/p][/*][*][p]Bones are dropped [b]while attacking[/b]—you no longer need to land the final blow to earn.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quests have been removed[/b] to streamline progression and focus on core combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skeleton achievements[/b] have been expanded and are now [b]fully activated[/b] on Steam.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Bug Fixes & Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Major [b]UI bug fixes[/b] and improvements to overall gameplay flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Skeletons can now be clicked accurately on the [b]head or torso[/b]—collision issues resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the infamous [b]sliding untouchable skeletons[/b] bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Skeleton [b]hit reactions[/b] are now smoother, with improved bounce and impact animations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spears, trails, and combat effects[/b] have been moved to [b]GPU particle systems[/b] for better performance and visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Background CPU saver no longer slows or pauses progress—[b]background gains are now stable[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌐 UI & Community[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [url="https://discord.gg/bEPxaaNKk8" style="button"]Discord Invite Button[/url] to the main menu—join the community and share your builds, bugs, and memes![/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Store visuals and screenshots[/b] have been updated to reflect the new look and feel of the game.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]That’s all for now!
Thanks for your continued support and feedback. While new content is on hold, expect more improvements, balancing updates, and refinements in the coming weeks. Keep slaying![/p][p]— [b]Kill the Skeletons Dev Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Alpha 11.11 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed: Weapons and upgrades not appearing in the Research Menu after being gained.

[*] Adjusted: Chaos Crystal cost for Click the Wizard has been significantly reduced.

[*] Improved: After a timeline reset, weapons no longer need to be unlocked one by one.
[/list]

notes.title: Relase Update - Kill the Skeletons Alpha 0.9.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551765/f5f6b4992b6d16361aa4a1c94c46072c5bcd9959.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551765/1e6ceea31fb02f7db5ea9f7dd0862715b8a8bc3e.png[/img]

Patch Notes – [Alpha Relase - 0.9.1]
Release Date: 21.05.2025

This update introduces new features, improvements, and several important bug fixes.


 New Features:

2D Mode Added
Players can now experience the game from a 2D perspective for a fresh gameplay experience. (This is actually a power efficiency mode :d)

Gameplay and System Changes:

[list]
[*] Weapon Star Upgrade System Reworked
[*] The star-based weapon upgrade system has been redesigned for better balance and clarity.

[*] Golden Skeleton Spawn Behavior Changed
[*] The golden skeleton no longer spawns as a button in the world.
[/list]

Performance and Technical Improvements:

[list]
[*] General performance enhancements implemented

[*] Improved lighting system for better visual fidelity

[*] Texture and model quality upgraded

[*] Optimized settings menu by removing unnecessary performance-draining options

[*] Fixed stuttering issues on the main menu
[/list]

Audio:
[list]
[*] Updated music and sound effects
[*] Audio has been refreshed to enhance the overall atmosphere and immersion.
[*] 
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed various weapons that previously contained bugs
[*] These weapons should now function as intended.
[/list]

We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates and new content!
